_doc: W4 SpecPIM baseline — the canonical prior-art comparison. PIM is on for attention acceleration (AAU fusion stays enabled because SpecPIM does accelerate attention on PIM). AHASD's adaptive stack (EDC/TVC/GTSU) is OFF, matching SpecPIM's static operator-level synchronous schedule with a fixed draft length. With `_ahasd==nullptr` the rank-switch lambda in SpecDecodeScheduler no longer fires, so this overlay exercises the true static-PIM-allocation regime SpecPIM describes.
